## Description

Couples recurrent neural networks with multivariate Hawkes point processes to forecast toxic order flow surges and adverse selection, dynamically triggering defensive option hedging rebalances.

## Where it may fit

Institutional option market making, toxicity avoidance, rapid hedging adjustments during market stress.

## Vehicles

Institutional Options Market Makers, Volatility Arbitrage Funds.

## Required data

Millisecond limit order book level 2/3 message streams, option implied volatility ticks, trade timestamps.

## Caveats

Low-latency C++ inference integration required for real-time hedging trigger activations.
